result.title: 全部藥品許可證資料集
result.description: 本資料集每週與藥證業務管理系統同步，藉此提供醫師、藥師、醫護人員、業者、民眾等使用者使用。
result.notes:
符合OAS標準之API說明文件網址:https://data.fda.gov.tw/
資料量大，以ZIP壓縮。
中藥藥品，請至此網站查詢： 
https://service.mohw.gov.tw/DOCMAP/CusSite/TCMLQueryForm.aspx?mode=1
警語:請勿自行決定用藥，使用藥品前，仍須經醫師診斷、醫師處方、藥師指導用藥後，方可為之。

en.title: All drug product approval data set
en.description: This dataset syncs with the pharmaceutical license management system every week, providing access to physicians, pharmacists, healthcare personnel, operators, and the general public.
en.notes: The API documentation URL that conforms to the OAS standard is: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId36The data is large and compressed in a ZIP file.For traditional Chinese medicine, please check this website: https://service.mohw.gov.tw/DOCMAP/CusSite/TCMLQueryForm.aspx?mode1Warning: Do not self-medicate. Before using medication, it is still necessary to be diagnosed by a doctor, prescribed by a doctor, and guided by a pharmacist.

resources.description: This dataset synchronizes with the pharmaceutical certificate business management system on a weekly basis to provide access to users such as doctors, pharmacists, healthcare personnel, operators, and the general public.
resources.fieldDesc: Permit number、Cancelled status、Cancellation date、Reason for Cancellation、Expiration Date、Issuance date、Types of permits、Old Certificate Number、Clearance visa application file number、Product name、Product name、Indication、Dosage form、Packaging、Drug category、Controlled substance classification level、Principal component analysis、Business name application、Business address application、Apply for a unified business number、Manufacturer name、Factory address、Manufacturer company address、Country of manufacture、Process、Change date、Dosage and administration、Packaging and International Barcode
resources.note: The API documentation website that complies with OAS standards is: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId36The data is large and compressed in ZIP format.For Chinese herbal medicine, please go to this website for inquiries: https://service.mohw.gov.tw/DOCMAP/CusSite/TCMLQueryForm.aspx?mode1Warning: Do not self-administer medication. Before using medication, you must still be diagnosed by a physician, prescribed by a physician, and given guidance by a pharmacist.
